pages.text: The Fluid Receiver receives fluids from target containers within its configured range.$(br2)$(bold)Variants$()$(br2)$(bold)Machine | Upgrade Slots | Receive Amount | Requires FE$()$(br)Basic Fluid Receiver | 4 | 20,000 mB | No$(br)Advanced Fluid Receiver | 4 | 20,000 mB | Yes$(br)Extended Fluid Receiver | 8 | 20,000 mB | Yes$(br2)$(bold)Features$()

$(li)Receives fluids from fluid containers within range into the internal tank$(li)Supports redstone control, Range Upgrade, and Filter Upgrade$(li)With an Overclock or Creative Upgrade and Auto Output enabled, fluid moves directly from ranged sources to Auto Output containers without using internal tank capacity$(li)Speed controls and Underclock adjust the operation interval; normal and overclock batches are configurable$(br2)$(bold)Crafting$()$(br2)$(bold)Basic Fluid Receiver$()
An extended version of the Advanced Fluid Receiver with 8 upgrade slots. Obtained by right-clicking an Advanced Fluid Receiver with an Extended Upgrade.
